item.title: Single-family home sells in Fremont for $1.8 million
item.description: A 1,923-square-foot single-family house, built in 1967, has changed hands. The house in the 35400 block of Purcell Place in Fremont was sold on Dec. 22, 2025 for $1,750,000, or $910 per square foot. This single-story house has four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Additionally, the home features two parking spots. The property occupies a lot of 5,800 square feet.

item.title: Single-family home sells in Milpitas for $1.4 million
item.description: The single-family house located in the 1600 block of Edsel Drive in Milpitas was sold on Jan. 22, for $1,415,000, or $696 per square foot. The home, built in 1963, has an interior space of 2,032 square feet. This single-story house has five bedrooms and three bathrooms. The interior features a fireplace. The property is equipped with a heating system. Additionally, the home includes access to a parking space for two cars. The property is situated on a lot spanning 6,322 square feet.
